_doc: The 3-commit Postgres->MySQL->NoSQL synthetic migration. Each commit lists the files written at that commit (full body). The benchmark builds a throwaway git repo by replaying these commits in order, so staleness is induced by a REAL git operation. Commit keys (P,M,N) are referenced by cases.json/conflict.json as read_at_commit.

commits.message: N: nosql adapter (one path still names the old store)
